notes.title: Now in beta: Attempt to reduce memory usage
notes.content:
Hey guys,

I just created a beta branch that features a new build that attempts to reduce the memory usage of the game. Furthermore it reduces the size of the game files on your hard drive disk by approximately 50%. Maybe all of this combined helps to speed up the initial load time of the game as well.

To opt-in to the beta branch:
1. Right-click on "Bullets And More" in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
2. Select the tab called "Betas"
3. Select the "beta" branch

The beta build is still compatible to the non-beta version and nothing has been removed. Basically just another compression method and a bunch of cleanup has been done to achieve this results.

[b]Warning: Switching to this beta build will basically require to re-download the whole game because every file has been affected.[/b] On the positve side the new game files should require a lot less space on your hard drive disk.

Please let me know if this actually helps (especially if you experienced memory issues before).

Wish you all a wonderful day and a nice weekend. :)

notes.title: Another update

Hey guys,

[list]
[*]Added climbing to all multiplayer game modes (with some limitations for balancing reasons):

[list]

[*]Bayonet is part of the gun and does not need to be attached

Furthermore I hope that the Bayonet on the K98 helps. I'm a bit afraid that it might be very strong in smaller maps but hopefully the fact that you need to use both controllers to make use of it helps with that.

Anyway let me know how this works for you. :)

notes.title: Update 53
notes.content:
Hey guys,

here goes another update. This update finally brings you some stats that are visible in-game (Main menu and loadout room) but can also be viewed with even more details here (most stats seem plausible but some might need another review though):
http://stats.bulletsandmorevr.com

Thanks to dogtato who basically created all the scripts for the web page and thanks to Daniel Webster for some of the design elements.

I received some complains about the map/mode voting system because it allows to "hijack" a full game by switching to a game mode that most people do not want to play. The best solution would be to just participate in the vote to avoid that. However due to the very different nature of BAM Royale I changed the vote value for it to 0.75 instead of 1.0. This will automatically require much more consensus to switch to BAM Royale. To make things fair: When playing BAM Royale and you want to switch to another game mode it will also require more votes to do so. I really hope that this turns out to be a good solution to the problem.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added stats for top Kills/Deaths and BAM Royale wins (visible in main menu and loadout room)
[*]Added ctf_apoc_island
[*]Attempt to fix helicopter joystick issues
[*]Added some announcement to Gun Game when you have taken or lost the lead to intensify this game mode
[*]Voting to leave or enter a BAM Royale game requires more votes now to ensure that there is enough consensus to do this (a vote is woth 0.75 instead of 1.0)
[*]Tiny recoil reduction for Pistol Cal. .50
[*]Removed Flare Gun from BAM Royale
[*]Some other fixes and changes
[/list]

I really hope you like the changes. Have a nice day :)
[b]
Multiplayer compatibility: Due to changes in the netcode this version is not compatible to old versions in multiplayer anymore.[/b]

notes.title: Update 51
notes.content:
Here goes another update! Took me longer than I wanted but had to fight with some Unity issues (also the reason why the update size is so huge; had to reimport a bunch of stuff).

The most important change is the addition of proximity chat to the team based modes. Concluding that you will need to use the radio to talk to distant people on the server or your team. You can toggle between "ALL CHAT" and "TEAM CHAT" by pressing the touchpad/stick in while holding the radio.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26176980/a7d2d93ce131e1896c898d80372af0b4f1fd4500.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26176980/a21388848c21b6a4209f2f42ae299d2110fb8739.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26176980/e49ead29b3abac2043d85b8f61466ffd50e907de.png[/img]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added proximity chat for BAM Royale, Virus, Team Deathmatch and Capture The Flag (use radio to talk to all people or to your team; toggle using touchpad)
[*]Added new weapon VSS
[*]Added new weapon AS VAL
[*]Aiming upwards should not reverse movement anymore (Touchpad)
[*]Added an experimental option to use Grip button to grab weapons (enable in Controls, Page 3)
[*]Further changes to allow for stats soon
[*]Improved muzzle smoke effect
[*]New firing sound for the M1
[*]Weapons firing from an open bolt will now correctly lock back and the bolt cannot be moved forward again (until it is released by pressing the trigger)
[*]Re-organized some maps (made a special vehicle category to highlight vehicle support)
[*]Re-organized weapon selection
[*]Buffed FG42 and Famas
[*]Updated tutorial a bit
[*]Further fixes and tiny changes
[/list]

[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
[list]
[*]Friendly vehicles are highlighted by green lights
[*]Helicopter altitude has been limited to ~800 m
[*]Steering wheel should work a bit better now
[*]Self destruction process only starts when no player is nearby the vehicle for 60 seconds
[*]Car should deaccelerate without any driver (instead of going on until it despawns)
[*]Helicopters and cars allow for roadkills now
[*]Added mirror to the car
[*]Car also takes damage on impact (two cars colliding can make them explode)
[/list]

[h1]Virus Infection[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fences in industrial are climbable
[*]Fixed possible exploits in sandstorm, concrete_jungle and industrial
[*]Infecting a player only adds 30 seconds to the round time instead of doing a full round time reset
[/list]

[h1]Capture the Flag[/h1]
[list]
[*]Flags (CTF) are now highlighted by a light beam
[*]Position of flag held by a player will now be visualized every 10 seconds
[/list]

[h1]BAM Royale[/h1]
[list]
[*]Most loot spawns have been moved to the inside
[/list]

[h1]Singleplayer modes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added some reverb effect to some scenes
[*]Last shot will now be visualized in Indoor Range (should be easier to practice that way)
[/list]

[h1]Scene Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added helicopter and car to the Scene Editor
[*]Added popup target (as seen in the tutorial) to the interactive target category
[/list]

Please let me know how this works for you. I have been testing the proximity chat and the radio with some people a lot and I really like it. It allows for a very new way of communicating with your team and is super helpful in all the team based modes. Give it some time before you judge it though.

Also let me know what you think about the new spawn locations in the BAM Royale map. Does it help? Should I consider to rework the spawn system completely and make it spawn weapon + magazines nearby? What would you guys enjoy the most? I'm willing to do that ;)

So what is the next step? Obviously I'm still working on the new map and I will be able to prioritize on this even more now. Furthermore I will try to also play around with teams i.e. Duos already. Not sure how long any of this is going to take but I will keep you guys updated.

Thank you for all your support. Looking forward for your feedback :)

[b]Multiplayer compatibility: Due to changes in the netcode this version is not compatible to old versions in multiplayer anymore.[/b]

[*]Added ability to change speed

notes.title: Update 43 - Stability improvements
notes.content:
Hey guys,

here goes another update :) 

[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/OdblO4W3aAu7S/giphy.gif]
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/RwKBD2cpL8WqY/giphy.gif]
Originally I wanted to take my time with this update but due to the reported stability issues since the last update I had to take action immediately. This update is very huge because I migrated the project yet again to a more stable Unity engine release and also made some changes in my own codes. Furthermore I had to touch every single scene in the project to fix some lighting issues (took me 3 days if you are curious).

I really hope this update gets rid of the stability issues. Please let me know if you are still experiencing crashes or other stability issues. You can always send me logs, bug reports and so on via mail: info@koenigz.com

Of course, this update also brings you other fixes and improvements. Fire selectors and bipods are now animated and more immersive. Objects located in your inventory are by default not interactable anymore. If you liked this feature in the past you can toggle it in the settings again. However it should be a lot more responsive, easier and more reliable to use especially for beginners in the default setting. For weapons I also added a requested harness feature. Just place a weapon in one of the bubbles and hover over the bubble with an empty hand. Now press the touchpad and it will turn green. If you pick this weapon and drop it, it will automatically return to your inventory again. Giving you even more flexibility how your inventory should behave. :)

Last but not least I noticed that the bots did not correctly respect the field of view values I gave to them. Resulting in way too responsive bots especially in easier difficulty levels. This has been fixed. Furthermore I gave them some more awareness if they are under fire. Concluding they should be a lot more fair but still more challenging especially in harder difficulty levels now.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Hopefully fixed game crashes
[*]Made inventory more forgiving and responsive (can be changed to old behaviour in settings)
[*]Added weapon harness feature to inventory slots
[*]Fixed some bot issues (not correctly applying limited field of view)
[*]Made bots more aware when being shot
[*]Polished some interaction visuals (bipods, fire selectors)
[*]Added some more haptic feedback
[*]Some other fixes and improvements
[/list]

As always l'm looking for your feedback and just let me know if you are experiencing any issues.

Thank you guys for your patience :)

notes.title: Update 40
notes.content:
Hey guys,

here goes another update. This time bringing you a parachute and two experimental helicopter testing maps. The helicopter has been available in a secret scene for a while already but I figured that testing it in public is more fun and will help to find issues even faster.

[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/YAb67c5IhtSlG/giphy.gif]
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/auT7E3skLu8so/giphy.gif]
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/11QCTAHig6eqQg/giphy.gif]

To test the helicopter host a new game and select the "Experimental" category. You will find a Team Deathmatch and Capture The Flag heli testing scene.

To activate the parachute you will need to be falling for a moment. You will see a release handle then that you need to pull. Don't wait too long as the parachute needs a moment before it can deliver the full brake power.

I'm well aware that those features are not for everyone. However sniping people out of the air is very satisfying and a lot of fun. Always try to snipe the people inside the helicopter. Shooting the helicopter with bullets deals damage but is rather inefficient. Shooting the chute has no effect at all because that would be very cruel and kill the fun as well.

Please keep in mind that the heli is still in the experimental category for a reason. Issues should be expected.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added new pistol TT33 for multiplayer (was in single-player before)
[*]Fixed an issue when bots have been visible in loadout room
[*]Added two helicopter testing maps
[*]Added parachute
[*]Added bolt lock to Vec
[*]Optimized sight and scope zeroing to fix some issues with the canted rail attachment and to increase overall accuracy
[*]Fixed an issue that potentially jammed weapons
[*]Fixed some potential sound glitches
[*]Fixed an visual issue in the bolt cycle feature (touchpad right for bolt-action rifles)
[*]Added new option to rotate playspace that allows to use the touchpad/sticks to rotate
[*]Fixed some AI issues in single-player
[*]Some other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

Have a nice weekend. Enjoy :)

Edit: Some issues have been found (sight tilting with weapon, parachute being unreliable and heli broken on xctf_heli_test) that I already fixed in a follow update. However Steam seems to have issues delivering updates at the moment. I hope you will receive those updates soon...

notes.title: Update 37 - Bots !
notes.content:
Hey guys,

finally here goes another update. This time featuring AI (also refered to as bots) for online and offline matches. The AI is also available in the demo and should help all the demo players who wanted to actually try the game but had no chance to do so in the past.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26176980/dc0a45fe6508c3a99b2f3a9198ca99c296023ab5.png[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/CiEDdq9KnPo1a/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/12LGOLP1zvqlhe/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26176980/1fbe218dd41527b290511724ef2e5308fc6bfd61.png[/img]
[h1]Features of the AI[/h1]
[list]
[*]The AI can be used in Deathmatch
[*]The AI can be used in Team Deathmatch
[*]The AI can be used in Gun Game
[*]You can decide to play online or offline
[*]You can change the number of bots at any time
[*]You can change the difficulty for every individual bot
[*]You can change the team for every individual bot
[*]Depending on the desired number of bots they will join and leave the game automatically
[*]Bots can use portals
[*]Bots can use some ladders but only in hangar (still testing and improving this)
[*]Bots can decide to crouch or to stand
[*]Bots can inform other bots (team based modes) about enemies
[/list]
[h1]Current limitations of the AI[/h1]
[list]
[*]While bots can use some ladders and portals they won't do that if not necessary
[*]Bots cannot use doors yet
[*]Not all maps are available yet (for instance maps that feature a lot of doors)
[*]While bots can play Gun Game they do not have a weapon order but use the same weapon
[*]Bots cannot win a round by score in Gun Game or Deathmatch but they can gain points for their team in Team Deathmatch
[*]Difficulty settings might be a bit off and need more testing to find the right balance for all of them (Very Easy, Easy, Medium, Hard, Godlike)
[/list]

I had a lot of fun developing and testing the AI so far and I'm really sure you will have even more fun. If you want you can also decide to play a round humans vs bots. To make this even more interesting I also added an option called "Bomber" that makes them not to use any weapon but they will drop a grenade when they come close and/or die. They also got a lot of health to compensate for the inability to shoot. Becase you can setup the options for every individual bot you can have a mix of different bot settings, too.

Of course, I also made a lot of other changes and improvements. Here is the changelog as far as I remember (probably forgot half ot the stuff again):

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added AI for online and offline matches
[*]Fixed an issue when you received two knifes
[*]When handling a bolt-action rifle (two handed!) you can press touchpad in right direction on your primary hand to operate the bolt without releasing your grip. Just cycle it and it will snap back to the weapon when you finished without any additional button press.
[*]Tracers for the M249
[*]New firing sound for Pistol 50. Cal
[*]Added another silencer so you can attach them to your primary and secondary weapon
[*]Made some Team Deathmatch maps also available in Deathmatch and Gun Game
[*]Some other fixes and improvements
[/list]

Let me know how it works for you.

Have a nice weekend and enjoy :)

Hey guys,

here goes another update. This took a while but I hope this time the update fixes all performance issues for real. In fact I already tested this update with some people and it was perfectly smooth and the increased network responsiveness felt just incredibly good. Before this update there was a very long delay before the kill has been confirmed and the enemy dropped to the ground. This confirmation should happen immediately now due to lots of optimizations to the game and the netcode.

Furthermore I tried to get two new game modes ready for you. The first mode is called Virus Infection. It is still experimental and needs more testing but usually works rather well and is tons of fun. One or two persons will be selected to start as infected persons and need to infect the other people. The other people however need to stay alive or they will become infected as well. To make this more interesting the infected persons carry no guns and need to come close to you. They got 2.5x more health and they can see friends and enemies through walls. Last but not least they do not need any ladders but can climb up walls and stuff. This mode might have some glitches especially after a map change but usually it sorts itself. Just keep that in mind.

The other game mode is called "Classic Deathmatch". You start with a pistol and you need to collect weapons in the map. The weapons respawn after 20 seconds so you can even dual wield and stuff. Definitely very cool as well.

However I think you really should take a look at the Editor if you haven't done so already. There are already some cool singleplayer missions and experiences in the Workshop. Just subscribe to them and select them in the panel you find when launched the Scene Editor. Concluding that even if you are not interested in building something yourself there already is a lot of content to try. Furthermore creating something in VR is a very cool experience especially when you make use of the giant mode and so on. Maybe give it a try at least. :)

I want to progressively make available all of the singleplayer weapons for multiplayer. I already started doing so by including the SMG90 and AKM in this update. Furthermore I think a much needed feature is to finally play Workshop levels without needing to update them the game.

[b]Due to the new weapons this game version is not compatible to older game versions in multiplayer anymore. So you definitely need to update to continue playing in multiplayer.[/b]

I hope all of that makes sense and you like the changes in this update.

Wish you all a nice weekend and don't forget about the Friday Night Events:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/525640/events/

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Update 20
notes.content:
Here goes another update :)

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Spawn points should take your room position into account now
[*]Added attachment pistol rail mount adapter
[*]Added attachment small sight 
[*]Fixed physics issue that caused ragdolls to glitch out completely (this could still happen if ragdolls are initialized inside each other but that should be less of a problem here)
[*]Fixed a possible visual glitch with the ground in the Editor
[*]Mixed Reality support should be fine now
[*]Some optimization to dm_rats
[*]Added blood decals
[*]Fixed an issue when you died without any visible reason
[*]Added basic layer system to the Editor to lock/unlock layers to prevent unwanted modifications and to increase performance 
[*]Added dm_space_chaos (featuring low gravity to test this in a multiplayer match)
[*]Added dm_vertigo
[*]Added tdm_vertigo
[*]Added ctf_vertigo
[*]Added tdm_shipment_demons
[*]Updated killhouse to most recent workshop submission and also added it for DM and CTF
[*]You are not forced to specific grenade types anymore but you can toggle them yourself
[*]Further optimizations to other modules
[/list]

So you can now assign layers to assets to lock them from being modified. This should be very helpful if you got a lot of assets overlapping each other. Furthermore all locked layers are passed through the scene optimizer and you should benefit from a much better performance while editing. This obviously comes at some loading time when locking/unlocking layers. If you spawn assets for an locked layer they will also spawn unlocked and you would need to toggle the whole layer on/off again to lock them as well. Furthermore if you run the scene you also would need to toggle the locking again.

The map tdm_shipment_demons is featuring some unsynchronized AI. Concluding that all players are seeing the enemies at different positions. It is kind of an experiment how that turns out and the story line would be that you are hallucinating.

The space map is featuring low gravity to see how that looks like. I see some of you might be wondering how they could survive in space and even shooting each other but I really think you should not take everything too serious because we are all here for having fun and not to re-create the real world (that often enough is not too much fun).

Let me know what you think about this update :)

Have a nice weekend and don't forget about the event today (Friday): http://steamcommunity.com/games/525640/events/

notes.title: Update 14 - Happy New Year 2017
notes.content:
Hey guys,

[b]Happy New Year 2017 !!![/b]

I just published an update :)

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Locomotion speed has been increased by a factor of 1.5
[*]The teleport beam is pointing 10 degrees more downwards
[*]Friendly Fire has been disabled for now (will become a mutator in the future)
[*]Some scope flickering issues have been resolved
[*]Fixed a recursive render loop caused by some attachments (if you noticed a game slow down when approaching the attachments table it was caused by this issue)
[*]Optimized some maps for even better performance
[*]Attemp to fix floating bodies when joining a game that has already been in progress for a while
[*]Fixed visual network issues with pistol slides
[*]Fixed suddenly missing reload sounds in multiplayer
[*]Increased size of Mute/Kick buttons
[*]Hosting selection now features categories for the game modes
[*]Fixed an issue when you could not teleport through objects in Edit Mode
[*]Attempt to prevent to use scopes and weapons through walls
[*]Button to return to lobby in loadout room
[*]Knife will respawn in your bubble after 12 seconds (to prevent griefing and to give it back if you dropped in such a way that you could not get it back)
[*]Demo maps are tdm_subway and ctf_hatfields_n_mccoys now
[/list]
The game is already featuring a kick function but the buttons (only visible for the current server admin - shown in the top left corner of the score board) used to be very small and I guess most of you guys have not even been aware of this functionality. The increased size should make them more visible because it seems some people only launch the game to kill as many people on their own team as possible. That is also the reason why I decided to disable friendly fire for now. However if they still try to harm the game I will add not only a temporaily ban function that you can use yourself to exclude them for your game session but I also will consider to implement a global ban function on my side to ban some people from multiplayer completely.

All I want is that you guys can enjoy this game as much as possible and if some people decide to destroy that experience I will take action. Stop stuff like that now or you will being stopped.

Anyway I really hope that you like the new locomotion speed and some of the other improvements. Just let me know how it works for you :)

[b]Edit:
I just published an update to this update to fix two issues I noticed with the portals and to add two new maps. The two new maps are chud and concrete_jungle. Please note that chud is featuring tons of lights and might be a bit problematic - but we will need to test that now.
[/b]

[b]Edit2:
- Fixed a new issue with the knife that did make stabbing impossible
- Fixed invisible walls in new map concrete_jungle
- Removed some lights in new map chud
[/b]

notes.title: Update 13
notes.content:
Hey guys,

finally here goes another update and I hopefully managed to fix all issues that forced me to unpublish Update 12. I'm very sorry about the delay but I hope you can enjoy this update even more now because I also made some more changes. I'm also very sorry about some other issues you guys have been experiencing. I was looking so much into multiplayer that I simply did not test the other stuff in a sufficient way anymore.

This is a rather huge update because I also switched to a new engine version. I hope this also helps with some crashes some of you have been experiencing. But maybe fixing some of the other issues also solved that. Let me know!

Here is a list of the changes:

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*]Got rid of the "Spawn" button and placed a portal instead. Just walk into it and you will spawn. Unlike the Editor portals you will NOT make any sound when you have been teleported to the new location (but could be done as well if you guys would like to see that).
[*]Map voting is enabled on all maps now. Demo players will auto-vote for the current map but could change the vote to another map they are allowed to play. If a map wins the vote that is not available for demo players they will be dropped out of the game and will see a message indication that the map is not available in the demo.
[*]Added [b]tdm_subway.[/b] It was a lot of work to optimize it. I really hope it works fine for you guys. Still might take some minutes for the initial loading because it uses some high quality stuff. :)
[*]Added [b]ctf_shi_tpa_town.[/b] It features tons of portals and it is nice to finally see them in Multiplayer. This level could be a bit confusing due to all the portals but you will get the idea after playing it a bit.
[*]Fixed some terrain issues on the desert map
[*]Fixed Voice Detection Threshold
[*]Changed the visuals of the loadout room
[*]Fixed missing custom loading screen while loading multiplayer levels
[*]Attemp to fix weapons on the floor/table of the loadout room that could not be picked up
[/list]
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed game freeze on loading some Workshop levels
[*]Fixed Player Spawn not working correctly
[*]FIxed Portals not playing sounds
[*]Removed distortion effect on portals because they have been way to expensive for the GPU
[/list]
[h1]Endless Breaching[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed unresponsive doors
[*]Fixed performance issues
[/list]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue when using Play Space Rotation that the Shotgun became unresponsive most of the times
[*]Fixed Multiplayer "Play" Button (it always required pressing it twice)
[/list]

I really hope everything works correctly and you can ejoy this update. I'm very curious what you think about [b]tdm_subway[/b] and how the performance is for you. I really did a lot to optimize it but I probably could do even more. Just let me know.

Next question is whether we should switch demo map(s). What should be next? Would like to hear your opinion on that but take your time to try the new maps as well. I setup a discussion for it already: http://steamcommunity.com/app/525640/discussions/0/152393186477914225/

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
Hey guys,

it has been a while but I got some new and pretty exciting stuff for you. Finally BAM VR is featuring a multiplayer mode that allows you to play Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch with up to 10 players. I have been actively developing the multiplayer mode within the last months and it has come a long way. Publishing it to the public branch now does not mean that it is finished nor complete but it means that it is stable and already tons of fun for sure!

This update also adds a new mode that I originally did not meant to add in this release because it is still a prototype and does not offer a lot functionality. The mode is called Endless Breaching and it is generating a fully procedural room setup that you can breach. Like I said it is still a prototype but maybe some of you guys can already enjoy it for what it is. More improvements need and will be made for sure.

I also added a new but still very experimental locomotion called Teleport_Skipping. It is a combination of Slide and Teleport.

This release also comes with tons of improvements and other adjustments. For instance I also redesigned the way how you select game modes and so on... I hope you like all of that but you can always start a discussion in the Community Hub if you would like to discuss something or just want to give some feedback. Feedback of any kind is always appreciated and will be taken very serious!

To help you to find a multiplayer match or to find people that you could play with I created this page: http://koenigz.com/bamvr/

It allows you to see people in the Lobby, in servers and people that have been launching the multiplayer mode before. It also allows you to visit their Steam profiles to befriend with them. Furthermore you will also find an upcoming events panel in the Multiplayer Lobby that will show upcoming events to come and play together. In fact if you know that you definitely got some free time at a specific time and date you could contact me to create an event for it so that other people will be aware that a game can be arranged at that date and time.

I really hope that all of this will help to compensate the still rather small user base.

See you soon and keep an eye on the events panel :)

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
Hey guys,

here goes another update that finally brings you a much better attachment system and I also took the chance to add some new and very exicting attachments like the attachable night vision.

The original game had a transparency effect for the menus that I had to remove due to some other issues. Now it is back and it seems to work alright. I'm looking for some feedback on it. Maybe give it some time because you have been used to the old look for quiet a while. I think it looks better and also should help a lot especially in the Editor.

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added transparency effect to menus
[*]Improved Attachment System for allowing to place multiple attachments freely on the rails
[*]Added new Attachment: Night Vision Optic
[*]Added new Attachment: Tactical Light
[*]Added new Attachment: Tactical Laser
[*]Added new Attachment: Holo Sight
[*]Added new Attachment: Scope
[*]Added new Attachment: Rail Raiser (useful to align Scope + Nigh Vision properly)
[*]Added Tactical Rail to SMG5
[*]Added Tactical Rail to Shot 12
[*]Added Tactical Rail to Pistol M9 (great for tactical light or laser sight)
[*]Added Tactical Rail to Pistol 1911 (great for tactical light or laser sight)
[*]Improved even more gun handling sounds
[*]Improved scope effect
[*]Improved some visuals for lights
[*]Improved haptic feedback for dry fire
[/list]
[h1]Time Shooting[/h1]
[list]
[*]Helicopter sound should be a bit less annoying
[*]Wood targets show bullet holes now
[*]Score multiplier is limited to 10
[/list]
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased lighting range for street lights
[*]Renamed options on AI Spawner to avoid confusions in the future:
[list]
[*]spawn_count is now active_spawns
[*]allow_respawn is now infinite_spawns
[*]spawn_min_interval is now min_spawn_time
[*]spawn_max_interval is now max_spawn_time
[*]reset_time is now respawn_time
[/list]
[*]Fixed an issue that AI Spawner did not cap AI correctly
[*]Replaced light setting "Night+Vision" with "Pitch Black" (use the new night vision attachment instead)
[*]AI Zombies, Soldiers and Turrets are now affected by light settings and feature reduced view distances based on that
[*]Added Gauge 12 clip for easier and faster reloading
[*]Added Gauge 12 flare clip for easier and faster reloading
[*]Gauge 12 Flare is now considered a low pressure round and will not cycle the weapon in the semi-automatic shotgun
[*]Objects will be aligned to snap points on Y-Axis only now. It originally was meant as a feature to allow it to snap in other directions as well but it simply does not make sense for the assets in the game and thats why I deactivated it for the other axis now. Probably should have done that way earlier.
[/list]

If you are using AI Spawner please make sure to load and save and/or re-submit your creation to make use of the automatically convertion of the old option values since the old options will become deprecated and removed in the future. For now they are still in the game but not visible. If you do not do that they will return to their default values once the compatibility feature has been removed.

I'm also interested in your feedback whether the laser sight is affecting the difficulty of Time Shooting or Holo Gun in a bad way. Probably it is not too much of an issue since other people got the same attachments (regarding scores).

I'm aware that there are still much more other open requests and I will try to address them within the next updates. I also plan on replacing the zombie models and some other effects within the next updates. 

Here is an example how some attachments could be combined:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26176980/4b2e1ad20e8cbc45e842086936446da0ce11d6bc.png[/img]

Stay tuned and have a nice weekend :)

notes.content:
Hey guys,

I just published another Update to the game.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that Game Menu using Touchpad locomotion was unopenable in some modes
[*]Changed all effects for muzzle flashes and impacts to more interesting effects (I hope this makes the weapon even more satisfying and fun to shoot. Looking for feedback on that!)
[*]Removed tracers to make the game not look cartoonish (you should not use them for aiming anyway and the new impact effects should give you a good feedback now)
[*]Improved the bolt action rifle interaction even further

[*]Remote interaction for UI also available in Edit Mode now
[*]Zombie textures are a bit higher resolution now

Due to lots of optimizations the game can handle it surprisingly well but you still should not overuse it and you also should place them wisely to avoid lighting glitches. At the moment the light will always be enabled for this asset. You cannot turn it off. I might change that in the future. Furthermore the light is only in a very small area to maintain performance. Might be useful to highlight some stuff or to add to the atmosphere of a scene.

If you haven't tried the Workshop support yet you really should look into the level called "Finding Sam". The user flibbertig155 really shows what the game already is capable of. Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Hey there,

here goes another update. This is a very important update because it finally adds the Workshop support I promised you and I keep my promises. Furthermore I added another menu option to the Edit Menu. Beside "Run Scene" you will also find "Optimize & Run Scene". This might take some seconds longer but should result in much better performance. It scans the scene before running it and tries to optimize it for better performance. I also improved the general performance of the game. While this has not been too important for the game modes it was absolutely necessary to support even larger custom created scenes. I also updated the locomotion to work more reliable and smooth. I hope you like it.

I also changed a lot of other stuff as you will see in the changelog below.

Maybe you are also interested in this Devlog video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ic06VQXLl4

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Workshop support (launch the Scene Editor to load, publish or update scenes). You will need to subscribe to levels in Steam to make them available in the game.
[*]Overall performance improvements
[*]Implemented a physics active locomotion that hopefully feels better and is more reliable
[*]Using touchpad locomotion you need to open the menu using the Application Button now
[*]You can now put up to three (small) magazines in one bubble
[*]Improved lots of weapon models and other visuals
[*]Added firing mode selection for weapons that support it (press touchpad in right direction, the current state is also visible on the weapon model itself)
[*]Changed grip angle for a more real feel on lots of weapons. I also moved the interaction zone a bit higher.
[*]Teleport now takes away energy and needs to recharge to teleport again (the amount of energy taken away depends on the teleport distance)
[/list]

[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with disappearing bullets using the Item Spawner
[*]Added a preview for the tile snap function
[*]Added scene optimizer ("Optimize & Run Scene")
[*]You can now override the AI settings using the "Level AI Settings" panel to change the number of dynamically created AI enemies to meet your skill and hardware the best
[*]Improved text input for Editor options (QWERTY keyboard)
[*]Added trigger asset to trigger state changes (i.e. start AI spawning)
[*]Room tiles are featuring options to disable ceiling, floor, windows (if featured)
[*]Added asset movement undo function (you can go 25 steps back, press touchpad down to open the now called Utility menu)
[/list]

[h1]Time Shooting[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added two new target types that will spawn at later game progress
[*]Tried to make it visually a bit more appealing and interesting
[/list]

    [*]Added option to reduce Gun Shot Sound Volume
 [*]Finished replacing all gun firing sounds and some handling sounds
 [*]Optimized Touchpad detection. Should (hopefully) be more responsive now.
 [*]Optimized Ammo Bag position and collider size. Should not interfere with picking up an object from ground anymore.
 [*]Optimized grip angle of M9 and AK5C (I cannot do better I think because it will lead to controller collision otherwise)
[*]Optimized the Bolt Action Rifle. Should be more responsive now.
[*]P90 is featuring a translucent magazine now.
 [*]Other minor improvements
[/list] 
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Implemented asset options (door states will now be saved)
 [*]Added category for 'Doors'
 [*]Added Door with Keypad (set code via options)
 [*]Added Tablet (set text via options, currently located in Category Misc)
 [*]You can now use remote interaction to open the Asset Menu to i.e. delete assets remotely
 [*]Removed grounding and remote interaction distance limit
 [*]You can become a giant now
[*]Assets no longer scale down when picking them up (use giant mode instead)
[*]Slightly reduced size of Zombies and Soldiers
[*]Added a mark to visualize where you will start in the Editor (so you can avoid to build something at the default level spawn)
[*]If no spawn points are placed and you die you will respawn at the location you started the level now
[*]Fixed an issue that AI soldiers tried to alarm other AI objects (they do not provide this functionality)
[*]Zombies will return to player if they are too far away
[*]Reduced speed of stag
[*]You can now sneak at the stag from behind
[*]You can place now Ammo, Attachments and Weapons (Category Spawning)
[*]Added general AI Spawning Asset (Category Spawning) that allows to respawn enemies after dead and some other stuff
[*]You can disable the Ammo Bags now (there is no alternative for them yet)
[*]You can give options to the crates to turn them into a lootable crate
[*]Basic Day-Night-Cycle Option
[/list] 
[h1]Time Shooting[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Targets will visualize disappearing a bit earlier now (to give more reaction time and help to prioritize)
[/list] 
[h1]Holo Gun[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You can now disable the slow motion feature
  [*]Optimized hit detection
 [*]Reduced projectile size a bit
[/list]

[list]
    [*]You can select a starting level now
 [*]Physics glitches should finally be gone (fixed this the third time haha)

[/list]

This update adds a new complexity level to the game that gives you a lot more power of the things in the game but we all know "With Great Power Comes Great Responsibility". If you really want to find out the limits or want to turn the game into a CPU+GPU benchmark please save your level before you do so. Spawning tons of enemies might render the game unresponsive and there is no way to stop it at the moment. Just saying.

notes.title: First Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
Hey,

I'm sure some of you already noticed that I published a small update. Beside some minor fixes and improvements there is an AI Zombie and a breakable and interactable door (press the door knob to open/close) now. Furthermore I added a new very experimental Touchpad locomotion as this seems to be in trend for obvious reasons now.

The AI Zombie features a very low poly model and also has a very low resolution texture. The texture will be improved in the future. However due to the low fingerprint you can place more than 100 of the in your level easily (they are not GPU bound but CPU bound). In combination with the Night or Dawn light setting and a flashlight it can become quiet creepy. The new added doors are also a great addition as you can search for cover in your house and close the door to keep them out. I'm already thinking about to make them break the door to come in. How does that sound?

The AI Soldiers cannot use the door yet. But I think they should be able to do that. What do you think about that?

The state of the door (open/close) will not be saved to file yet (I will implement that when I'm implementing options for other objects as well) but the state will be kept for the time you are using the Editor. So if you open a door in Edit Mode it will also be open in Play Mode and will return to this state if you return to Edit Mode again.
